title: Our Everlasting
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Horyuu is a dazzling surfer idol; Shouin, calm and reserved, is drawn to him, and the two cannot forget a secret confession they once shared. The two-volume collection also includes one-shots, one about a 35-year-old art teacher who refuses a risky heart operation and chooses to live out a few more years, and a prequel to the author's Kurumi no Naka.
life_message: Love and a life fully lived matter more than safety or appearances.
